text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Mmh. Come to think of it, they were 
away tonight. ————Ah well, so be it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, with no one around to urge her 
through her bedtime routine, Orfevre 
stayed up until the dead of night, utterly 
absorbed in her book...
